Notes: riyade-coming-soon — scope, the copy and where it shows, verification, and the entry proposed for erp-docs

The branch's own record while erp-docs stays outside the brief: why the work is on a candidate branch rather than on
tsx-public-site (which publishes tsxmr.com), the approved copy in three languages and every placement, the two
sentences that became untrue, the look, the verification of the final tree (typecheck, Vitest 552, both surfaces'
refusals, builds, link and bundle audits, e2e full 134 and public 172 twice, PUBLIC_WEBSITE GO, a page-by-page
comparison with production's build), what was found and fixed, what was observed and left, the owner's decisions,
and the decision entry (D217 at the time of writing) to record in erp-docs once the owner approves.
